title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More — Episode6 Showing We're Serious

meta.Event Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: A few hours later
Hanamioka Town Hall

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP! is now on the set!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, I thought you'd be used to this by now. We're gonna be working on this for a pretty long time, so pull yourself together already.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... Today's shoot involves us meeting with the operations committee, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's the plan.
I'm looking forward to seeing what they're like.
Oh, you must be MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
My name is Tamura. I'm the chairman of the operations committee, and very much looking forward to working with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What...? The chairman?!
Yes, we're looking forward to working with you as well!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We promise to do our absolute best.
Oh, my name is Haruka Kiritani from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm familiar with you ladies.
I'm actually the one who sent in the request to this program.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I didn't know...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: I'm sure that you've all heard by now that our town has been in a downturn these past few years. With fewer young people around, our once bustling community has become so diminished...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: It's honestly quite a sad sight.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mr. Tamura...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
But it really is a wonderful place...
The food is delicious and you're surrounded by nature.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: The view from the observation deck is truly spectacular. Not only can you see the mountains and entire town, but they transform with each season.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
That's why we began holding the town marathon.
Showing people just how beautiful this place is should help bring in more tourists and new residents...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: But things haven't quite been going as we planned. If matters continue like this, this town won't be able to spare the budget for the marathon much longer.

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: That was when I learned about this program. And through them, we've decided to bet on you young ladies.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for telling us all this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For the sake of this town you all love so much, we promise to do our best to make others feel the same way through this event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, more people are starting to come in. They must be the rest of the operations committee.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go introduce ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um, excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Operations Committee Members
rows.Line: U-Uhh... Thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is it just me, or are they trying to avoid us?)

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Ah, that makes everyone from the operations committee. Alright, please gather up so that we can all introduce ourselves.
A few hours later
Town of Hanamioka - Observation Deck

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Something felt off even when we were introducing ourselves. We didn't seem entirely welcome...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (At the same time, I sort of understand why they'd be so hesitant. I mean, I'd feel uncomfortable too if a group of outsiders came out of nowhere and said they'd like to help with my town's marquee event...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I must've spaced out for a second.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More importantly, we need to start coming up with ideas to make sure the marathon succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. First, we need to get ourselves familiar with Hanamioka by taking a stroll around town.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still, this really is a wonderful place...
All this greenery and fresh air...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I know, right?! And the food's delicious!
The meats and veggies at the little eatery we just visited were so amazing! I couldn't put my utensils down!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, their dishes really brought the ingredients' flavors to life. We'll need to be careful not to overeat.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's the matter, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Look, everyone.
There's a beautiful flower field over here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow... It is beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and check out all the different flowers. You really only get to see stuff like this in places where nature's been allowed to just be.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I hope the runners also get to see this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, wait... The marathon's not for a long time, so these flowers might be gone by then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But there might be a way to still make use of them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, what if we...

Are they sure about this?
I mean, they're idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(...?
Are those people by the side of the road talking about...)

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: And so young, too. You have to wonder if they'll be any use at all.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
Not likely.
I doubt they know the first thing about this place, so don't get your hopes up.

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line:
Honestly, what is the chairman thinking, calling in that television crew?
Can't he see that we're doing our best here? Does he think this is just for fun?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They're on the operations committee, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow... I didn't realize that's how some people felt about all this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me neither...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's also proof that they're serious about what they're doing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's normal for them to be wary of outsiders and those they think they can't rely on. Their town is just that precious to them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, it's up to us to be the best diplomats we can, to help ease their worries.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We have to take this marathon and our interactions with the locals very seriously. We need to show them that we're going to do our absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Because we're here to spread hope to the people of this town!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're gonna do everything we can to help and make it so everyone's smiling in the end!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, so... Going back to the flower field...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Hanamioka Town Hall

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Rolling in five, four, three...

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line: Alright, let's start discussing ideas regarding how to improve our marathon. Who would like to begin?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Umm... In that case, would it be okay for us to go first?

rows.Speaker: Chairman
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
The floor is yours.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: While taking a walk around your town and actually running the marathon course...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We experienced Hanamioka's natural beauty and delicious food, and learned what a wonderful place it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we thought it might be good to start telling people online through social media. Would it be possible to start some official accounts?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have a feeling that a lot are going to say, “Imagine running while enjoying all this gorgeous scenery,” or, “The food here looks amazing,” and want to learn more about your town.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Naturally, we'll be taking the lead in terms of doing interviews, posting new content and keeping the updates going.

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Yes, we were also thinking about doing more through social media, so your help would be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, we have an idea regarding what's passed out at the refreshment stations!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We were told that besides drinks, you offered candy and chocolate to help people recharge up through last year...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we thought that you could start offering things that used local Hanamioka ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How does that sound?!

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: Yes, it could be an opportunity to spread the word about all the delicious foods our town has to offer...

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: But we can just buy snacks and the like. Making something would take more budget, and more hands.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, so please feel free to discuss your budget options before you decide.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll also be available to help with any extra work that needs doing, so we hope you'll give this some thought.

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If I may, we have one last idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What if we handed out pressed-flower bookmarks?

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Pressed flowers?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: During our walk, we stumbled across this really beautiful flower field!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were hoping that the runners would also get to see it, but then we realized that certain flowers won't be in bloom when the marathon actually happens.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, we thought that turning them into bookmarks would be nice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'd be able to share with them what we saw, and they might want to come visit again when the fields are back in full bloom.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Local B
rows.Line: I agree. The flower fields are one of our most treasured assets, so let's take it into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We should be able to make them as long as we're given some backing paper, so we're hoping you'll take this idea into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Here we...aah!
No, this daikon refuses to come out of the ground. It must be very big...

rows.Speaker: Local Elderly Lady
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, putting you to work pulling veggies. My back has just been so sore lately...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not at all. We'll be using them for the marathon, so it's our pleasure to help.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, there's a ladybug on your nose...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right.
It's a little... Achoo!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh no...! I'm losing my balance... Eep!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Ma'am, look! Falling helped me pull out the daikon! It's so big!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Phew...
I'm done cutting all the wood.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I just finished painting the outward-facing sections! Our stage should be ready in time for the marathon now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and we have the local carpenter to thank for teaching us everything. Left to our own devices, we could've worked for a year and not gotten this done.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna sing and dance on this stage so that all the runners participating will be able to get through the mountainous course!
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
...
Coming along?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Hi, Boss!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Thought it might be about time we start putting screws in, so I came to see how you two were doing...

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: You've cut some beautiful cross sections here. And you've done a good job of putting on even coats of paint for these.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Yeah. It'll do.

rows.Speaker: Airi & Minori
rows.Line: B-Boss...!

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
MMJ's working so hard.
They've really been getting to know the community.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
I honestly didn't think they'd be willing to go this far for this town.

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line: If things keep going the way they have been and the marathon succeeds, then we should be able to get all the footage we need...
The day before the marathon

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Hanamioka Town Hall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I've finished making our posts for the day on social media.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're getting a lot more views on #HanamiokaMarathon too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks to that, it sounds like this year's marathon is getting a lot more applications than last year...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: E-Everyone, we have an emergency!
